activation: explicit separate human ratification and reviewed consumer adoption; no enforcement installed
adoption: ratchet/enforce only after explicit mature scoped adoption

freshness.clock: explicit as_of UTC; reject future observations
freshness.incomplete_inventory: unknown freshness unless a witnessed material event or deadline proves stale
freshness.invalidation: preserve historical decision; expose stale effective posture without rewriting source
freshness.materiality: only explicit scoped sourced events following the represented assessment; routine revision differences are independent
freshness.valid_until: optional explicit source deadline; stale only after this deadline

human_evidence: Raw record fields only declare claims. Separate trusted human-source context must bind exact canonical statement, scope, revisions and assessment digest. No context means unverified, never ratified.
non_goals: replacing ADRs, audits, conformance, CI, health or release readiness

ownership.aether: portable full review/assessment contract, prompts, templates and read-only authoring skill
ownership.hygiene: applicability, governance, freshness and human-authority semantics
ownership.observatory: privacy-safe read models and queries; preserves source claims versus verified authority
ownership.pace: reviewed adoption proposals; no automatic authority or enforcement
ownership.relay: bounded evidence capture, verification, artifacts and repository presentation
ownership.repository: canonical facts, public admission, human governance sources and final publication
